title: fix(objectql): recompute a disabled package's extension roll-ups when it is enabled again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg2u15WkFyGtun9mJtYPTkdg)_
domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个模块用扩展给别的模块的对象加了汇总字段（例如给客户加「拜访金额合计」），汇总的子记录属于仍启用的应用。模块停用期间子记录照常写入，但汇总不重算；现在模块重新启用时会把这些汇总按每条父记录重算一遍，只改值不一致的行。
- 为什么改：#30377。PR #30362 停用时隐藏模块加的字段，汇总索引也跟着少了这个汇总，于是重新启用后汇总显示停用那一刻的旧值，直到下一次子记录写入。
- 风险与回滚：启用接口（`PATCH /packages/:id/enable`、安装时 `enableOnInstall: true`）现在等重算完成再回答，父记录多时启用会变慢；某行重算失败只记 error 日志，不让启用失败。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/summary-enable-refresh.ts`（整文件，重算逻辑）；`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `enablePackage` 与新 `onPackageEnabled`；`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 两处 `await summaryRefreshSettled(qlService)`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-summary-disabled-extension-reenable.test.ts`，预期 4 个全绿（第一个用例停用期间写子记录，启用后汇总读到 25 而不是 10）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30377

Clause-②: no — a stored summary column stays current across a disable; nothing a caller sends is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

While a package is disabled, the `summary` fields its `objectExtensions` add to another package's object are withheld from the served fold (#30304), and `ObjectQL.buildSummaryIndex` reads that fold, so the summary is not in the roll-up index. When the summary's child belongs to an enabled package, the child writes made during the disable land and recompute nothing. After the enable the parent serves the value the summary held at the disable, until a child write names it.

**Route chosen: recompute the withheld summaries on enable** (the card's second option), not an index over the storage fold. Why:

- The recompute writes the parent through `ObjectQL.update`, whose field map is the served fold. A withheld column is refused there as an unknown field (`INVALID_FIELD`), by #30304's design. An index over the storage fold would turn each such child write into a `SummaryRecomputeError` (a 500 on a committed write), unless the write path grew a second, storage-level door for one kind of column.
- The column is not served while its package is disabled, so nothing reads it stale before the enable. Recomputing it at the enable makes it current at the first moment it is served again, through the one write path and the one aggregate (`aggregateSummaryValue`) the engine already uses.

Changes:

- `registry.ts`: new `SchemaRegistry.onPackageEnabled(listener)`, announced by `enablePackage` only when the package was disabled (never for an enable of an enabled package, e.g. a fresh `enableOnInstall: true`). Same shape as `onPackageUninstalled` (#30215): one signal for every enable door, never per door; a throwing listener is logged at `error` and never fails the enable.
- `summary-enable-refresh.ts` (new): `refreshSummariesExtendedBy` takes the roll-ups the package adds by extension (`getObjectExtensionsOf`, matched to the engine's own `getOwnedSummaryDescriptors` index), walks every parent row in keyset order, recomputes each one with `aggregateSummaryValue`, and updates a row only where a value differs (an enable over unchanged children writes nothing). A failed row is recorded and the walk goes on; failures are logged once at `error` with consequence and fix. `startSummaryRefreshOnEnable` is the listener (tracks the run, never rejects); `summaryRefreshesSettled` waits for the runs in flight.
- `registry-module-mock.ts`: the shared registry double answers `onPackageEnabled` (the engine's constructor subscribes; the double never enables a disabled package, so it never announces).
- `engine.ts`: the constructor subscribes the listener; two public delegations: `refreshSummariesEnabledBy(packageId)` (the operator's re-run after a logged failure) and `summaryRefreshSettled()`.
- `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` and the install door's `enableOnInstall: true` arm answer after `summaryRefreshSettled()`, so the first read after the answer serves current values. An engine without the member (a test double) answers at once, as before.

Only summaries added **by extension** are walked. A summary on an object the disabled package OWNS stays in the index during the disable (its objects are refused on the data plane, not withheld from the fold) and kept tracking an enabled child; measured with a probe before writing this (the parent read 7 during the disable after a child write of 4 over 3).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-summary-disabled-extension-reenable.test.ts` (new): the card's scenario (module B extends app A's parent with a `sum` over A's child; disable B; insert, update and insert children of two parents; enable B; the parents read 25 and 7 with no further child write); an enable with no child moved writes no parent row; one parent's failing recompute leaves the others current, logs one `[summary-refresh]` line at `error` naming the row, and `refreshSummariesEnabledBy` re-runs it; `onPackageEnabled` fires for a disabled-to-enabled switch only, and not after unsubscribe.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts`: new describe through the real routes on SQLite (`PATCH /packages/:id/disable`, `/data` writes of the app's child, one under a parent created during the disable, `PATCH /packages/:id/enable`, `GET /data`), with a third module added only for that describe (`suiteArtifact(…, withRollup)`). #30304's own case (child in the same disabled module) is unchanged and still green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Second item of seat note 6654197160 (`os migrate` value-rewrite commands under `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/` scope by the served fold): follow-up owed.** Not the same package (`packages/cli`), and the smallest honest answer the note names (the plan names the columns it skipped, or the run refuses while an extending module is disabled) is a CLI output change, while switching the reads to the storage fold needs engine support (`engine.find` refuses a withheld field by design). Not taken here.
- The enable doors now wait for the walk: its cost is one aggregate per parent row of each extending roll-up (keyset pages of 500). A deployment with a very large parent table pays that once per enable.
- The refresh runs on the `onPackageEnabled` signal, so a package that comes back enabled WITHOUT an enable (a state file edited or removed between two boots) gets no refresh; its summaries correct on the next child write, as before this PR. The protocol's install door (`metadata-protocol`, `enablePackage` on install) gets the refresh too, but answers without waiting for it.
- The walk reads and writes as system (`{ isSystem: true }`), the context `backfillSummaryNulls` (#6063) already uses for the same aggregate.

## Verification

All on head `4ca13802` (origin/main `35a8f088` merged once; main has moved since and `git merge-tree` against it is clean).

<details><summary>Red on main, green on the fix, two ablations</summary>

- Red on main `8e5fabe5` (the new objectql pin, tests only): `AssertionError: expected 10 to be 25` — the parent serves the value it held at the disable.
- Green: `engine-summary-disabled-extension-reenable.test.ts` 4/4; `packages-disable-module-extension-fields.test.ts` 12/12 (the new describe plus #30304's own cases unchanged).
- Ablation 1, the engine's subscription (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `this._registry.onPackageEnabled(…)` line in `engine.ts`; the objectql suite imports `src/`, no build between): anchor 1 to 0, blob `09031204d5df` to `0e83c65fd80e`; `Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)` (`expected 10 to be 25`, `expected +0 to be 7`; the no-write control and the registry case stay green, as predicted); restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, the door's wait (`--delete` of `await summaryRefreshSettled(qlService);` in the `PATCH /packages/:id/enable` arm; the runtime suite imports the dispatcher from `src/`): anchor 1 to 0, blob `8d43ff30f3e1` to `ae9427714d6b`; `Tests  1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, the new describe reads the pre-recompute row; restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. So the answer-after-recompute is pinned, not only the recompute.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` under the verify lock: `Test Files  553 passed (553)` · `Tests  11009 passed (11009)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`. (A first run before the registry double gained `onPackageEnabled` was red in 19 files that mock `./registry`; that is the `registry-module-mock.ts` change.)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: `Test Files  543 passed (543)` · `Tests  8656 passed | 19 skipped (8675)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql run typecheck` and `@objectstack/runtime`: exit 0, test layers included (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, ledgers unchanged).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the seven changed source and test files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's Lint job.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `4ca13802`: 63 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, plus `check:facade-delegation-only`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:route-ledger-census`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:changeset-fixed` (rosters under the touched trees): all exit 0. `--ran`: `63 derived, 62 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`; the one is `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3, needs an unshallow clone; checker health only), which CI runs.
- Fixed on the way: `check:objectql-double-limit` (the new `find` double now slices by `limit` before touching rows) and `check:query-options-erasure` (no `as any` on the new test's query options).
- Dogfood battery: n/a, no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
